label: PROBE
blurb: Answer a question about the code or system.

stages.label: DIG
stages.instructions: Investigate. Read the code, run read-only commands, follow the evidence. Avoid mutating anything. Note findings as you go; advance when you can answer.

stages.label: REPORT
stages.instructions: Answer the question directly, then the evidence (file:line, command output). End with a recommendation and how confident you are.
